dialect.detail: Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or similar open-source COBOL; uses LINE SEQUENTIAL organization, GOBACK, and structured IF/END-IF consistent with COBOL-85. No mainframe-specific extensions detected.

purpose.domain_detail: Control break reporting exercise processing a two-level hierarchy (A-ID and B-ID) with counters, producing a formatted report
purpose.summary: CONBRE2 is a two-level control break batch program that reads records from DATA2.DAT, accumulates totals at B-ID and A-ID levels, and writes a formatted report to REPORT2.RPT. It demonstrates nested control break logic with subtotals and a grand total footer.

notable_features: Two-level nested control break logic (A-ID outer, B-ID inner)
PERFORM THRU paragraph exit pattern throughout
88-level condition names for file status checking
DISPLAY UPON CONSOLE for error handling
Commented-out header and debug DISPLAY statements visible in source
No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS
GOBACK used instead of STOP RUN for normal termination
verdict.notes: Author field 'MUKKU' and the educational control-break pattern strongly suggest a student exercise. The program is complete and well-structured with consistent error handling, but the domain and simplicity indicate academic use. Some commented-out lines suggest iterative development.
